title: Web Live gets the Mac's keys: Space, ←, → and Esc
acceptance: In Live, Space plays or pauses, ← goes to the previous track, → goes to the next and Esc exits Live, as in the Mac's Live window.
None of them fires while typing in a field (input, textarea, select or contenteditable).

While the seek strip (LiveTimeline: arrows seek 5 s) or the view toggle (arrows switch views) has focus, its keys do only what they do today, and the global ← and → do nothing. Neither handler stops propagation today, so a global handler must check focus itself.
The menu keys (⌘N, ⌘R, ⇧⌘M) stay Mac only, because browsers use ⌘N and ⌘R.
Tests cover each key and the typing and focused-control exceptions.
08's Live keys row (RF-233's Mac column) says the web has the keys, and the iOS web-contract copy of 08 is refreshed in an iOS PR as soon as this merges, because 08 drift fails iOS parity.
nextAction: Agent-created (Neo, 2026-11-20) from the owner's 2026-11-19 decision on the RF-1201 Mac design audit (iOS RF-1213; the Mac side is iOS RF-1212). Backlog until the owner sets Ready. LiveMode.tsx is owner-gated (playback), so the PR gets needs-owner. Two points to settle when it is set Ready: whether Space plays or pauses while a button has focus, or keeps the button's own Space (the view toggle uses Space and Enter today); and whether Esc exits a running class at once, as the web's Exit control does today with no confirmation, or asks first. An open dialog already keeps Esc to itself (Dialog.tsx stops its propagation).

evidence.summary: Owner decision, Neo session, 2026-11-19: "Yes, a web task". Web Live gets the Mac's Space, ←, → and Esc, except while typing, with a focused seek strip or view toggle keeping its arrows. The menu keys stay Mac only (the agent's stated default; the owner didn't object).
iOS RF-1213 records the decision in web-parity.md › Owner decisions, item 14, and names this web half for a web PR.

#777's final review (non-blocking points 2, 4 and 5): the 08 row with its iOS refresh, Esc on a running class, and the focused controls' unstopped propagation, checked against LiveTimeline.tsx and LiveMode.tsx on main c279df9.
